description:
Problem. _project/baselines/perf_smoke_duckdb_tpch_001.json holds per-query medians measured while qgen and dialect translation were inside the per-query timer (about 5 ms per query against baseline queries of 4.4 to 12.3 ms). After power-test-times-query-generation-20261031 lands, nightly measurements shift down by roughly that cost, which weakens the gate's sensitivity for queries the gate previously watched and invalidates the floor derivation (7 ms per query, 82 ms aggregate) that used the old noise.

Method (existing, from the earlier baseline rebuild): per-query medians over at least five retained t3-perf-result artifacts from scheduled nightly-v2 runs on develop on the same runner class, recorded with source run ids next to the file (perf_smoke_duckdb_tpch_001.sources.json) and the method in docs/internal/perf-smoke.md. Build it with scripts/perf_smoke_baseline.py, which owns the runner-class rule (the slowest CPU model with at least five results); do not substitute another rule.

Floor decision: whether the 7 ms and 82 ms floors remain right under the post-change noise is decided by nightly-perf-gate-sensitivity-review-20261010, which waits on this item; this item only reports the measured same-class spread.

Purpose narrowing to re-home: docs/internal/perf-smoke.md says the gate exists to surface regressions in dialect translation and validation, and dialect translation runs inside get_query, which power-test-times-query-generation-20261031 moves out of the compared timer. Detecting translation and orchestration regressions is re-homed to recommendation 3 of docs/internal/nightly-perf-gate-review.md (collect run.total_duration_ms and phase durations), whose implementation TODO the nightly review item creates before it closes.

Timing: this item's not_before is set by the agent who finishes power-test-times-query-generation-20261031 to the merge date plus 7 days. Sources do not exist until the change has run on develop for at least five nights; do not fabricate or locally substitute runner results. Use not_before or wait for the artifacts.

Guardrails for all code work: work only in a linked worktree (make worktree-create); never edit the primary clone. No explanatory comments or docstrings in source (make comment-policy-check). Durations use benchbox.utils.clock.mono_time()/elapsed_seconds(). Add a changelog.d/ fragment. Cited line numbers are orientation only: re-read the named symbols, docs and spec clauses before editing and treat a mismatch as a reason to stop and update this item. No live-cloud runs without owner approval; heavy runs only through make heavy-run or a lock-taking entry point. Green focused tests are not release certification. Do not edit the baseline from a local macOS run; the earlier baseline was rebuilt precisely because a single local run moved the noise problem.
